name: english-anticipatory
situation: P4 Sarah: 영어. 말기 신부전 고양이 Milo, 예기 애도, 안락사 시점 조언을 구한다
turns: I noticed last month. Milo stopped jumping on the bed. The vet says his kidneys are failing, maybe weeks left. I keep googling treatments at 3am instead of sleeping. Everyone says enjoy the time you have left but I can't stop crying when I look at him.

He still comes to me but he's so light now. I'm scared I'll have to decide when. My husband thinks I should let him go now so he doesn't suffer, and I feel like he's rushing me. How do you know when it's time?
Sunshine. He drags himself to the window patch every morning. I guess that's my answer, when he stops doing that. Thank you, I don't think I've said any of this out loud before.
He used to chase the laser dot up the hallway wall like a maniac. Okay, I need to go feed him. Thank you.
